subject: Service interruption — proposed credit & rollover offer
messages:
From: Sasha Gomez <sasha.gomez@midline-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@midline-retail.com
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spike during morning ingest window — impact & ask

Hi Hannah,

We observed a sustained latency regression on Redwood between 07:15 and 08:05 PDT this morning that affected our background embedding ingest pipeline. Average p95 token latency spiked from ~120ms to ~1.2s and we saw ~18% failed requests during the window. This caused a backlog in our downstream re-ranker and delayed several customer-facing updates.

Can you confirm what happened and whether Midline is eligible for credits? We are still in our trial (trial-id: MID-TRIAL-209) and that spike materially impacted our ability to hit the demo we have with a large buyer next week.

We'd also like to request: (1) a short incident summary (timeline + root cause), (2) a credit that offsets the impacted usage for the window, and (3) a 30-day trial extension or rollover of any unused promotional credits so we can stretch the evaluation window.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and the next steps.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Gomez
Head of Platform Ops — Midline Retail
Ops: ops@midline-retail.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Latency spike during morning ingest window — impact & ask

Marissa / Karthik — looping you both in. Sasha just reported a pretty impactful morning latency/regression while Midline is on trial. They specifically asked for a timeline, credit to cover the impacted window, and a 30-day trial extension or rollover of promotional credits.

Quick facts from the stack: I can pull the token-level usage and p95 logs for 07:00–09:00 PDT (will attach). I want to propose: a credit equal to the actual billed token usage during the regression window (we can cap to $3k as a first pass), plus a 30-day trial extension and an automatic rollover of currently unused promo credits into their account.

Questions: are we comfortable with the $3k cap? Do we need legal sign-off for a rollover? If finance needs a code or journal entry I can run it through. Marissa — can you draft the customer-facing language, and Karthik if you want to mention any contractual constraints?

I'll attach the usage_report_apr29.csv and a short debug timeline I generated.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: usage_report_apr29.csv (token counts per minute), debug_timeline.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency spike during morning ingest window — impact & ask

Hannah / Karthik — thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the usage CSV: Midline had ~1.1M tokens billed during the regression window; at their current trial plan that maps to roughly $2,300 in billed units. Suggested offer:

- Apply a $2,300 service credit to cover affected usage (journal entry DL-CR-78421).
- Issue a 30-day trial extension tied to their existing trial-id (MID-TRIAL-209).
- Roll over remaining promo credits (they have 25% of initial promo untouched) into a customer promo balance that expires 90 days after issuance.

I think a $2.3k credit + 30-day extension + rollover is proportionate and avoids setting a broad precedent. I'll prepare the customer note and copy legal if needed for the promo rollover language. Finance will need the chargeback code — I'll request DL-CR-78421 be posted and give Hannah the refund token/code.

If Karthik wants to sweeten with an additional 1-week demo support window (engineer on the call) to ensure their buyer demo runs smoothly, that could help close them.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: usage_report_apr29.csv (attached)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Gomez <sasha.gomez@midline-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike during morning ingest window — impact & ask

Hi Sasha — thanks again for raising this and apologies for the disruption you saw on April 29. We've completed a preliminary review and want to make a concrete offer while we finish the postmortem: 

Summary of what we'll do for Midline Retail
- Service credit: $2,300 applied to your account to offset billed usage during the 07:15–08:05 PDT regression window (journal DL-CR-78421).
- Trial extension: 30 additional calendar days added to MID-TRIAL-209 (no action needed on your side).
- Promo rollover: any unused promo credit on file will be converted to a promo balance for your account and will expire 90 days after issuance.
- Support: we'll provide a dedicated 60-minute technical prep call (available next week) to help stabilize the demo path — Marissa will coordinate scheduling.

We have attached a short incident_postmortem.pdf (draft) that explains the timeline and root cause; we'll send the finalized document once we complete log correlation. You should see the credit applied in the console within 48 hours and the trial extension reflected on your account page.

If you accept this resolution, please reply with "I accept" and we'll finalize the journal entry and promo rollover. If you'd prefer a different structure (e.g., token top-up instead of dollar credit), let me know and we can adjust.

Sorry again for the outage — we appreciate your patience and are committed to making the trial evaluation smooth.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments (stubs): incident_postmortem.pdf, usage_report_apr29.csv
